input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: Template-literal message with unescaped backticks crashed analyze() on the first try; no existing test covered the empty-range path, so node --test stayed green until the new test was added.
Downloading semver 7.8.6 from the npm registry to compare was refused by the session's permission classifier; the minVersion quirk is reported against 7.7.4 only.

doc_friction.issue: Page links still point at duncan-haywood.github.io (redirect host) rather than marisstella.app; left as is, likely generator-owned.

notes: Explore idea: differential-test node-version-drift-check's hand-written semver range parser against npm's bundled node-semver 7.7.4 (range.diff.test.mjs). 150,000 seeded ranges: 0 disagreements on 794,376 satisfies checks and 65,063 intersects pairs of satisfiable ranges; 0 ranges node-semver accepts were rejected. Found and fixed: unsatisfiable engines.node (>=20 <18) was reported as engines-unbounded (reverse of the truth); now engines-unsatisfiable, pins not blamed. Leading-zero numeric parts now rejected. Documented node-semver quirks: intersects true for empty ranges (1,257/51,751), minVersion null across || on 3,955/132,396 satisfiable ranges. Checks: node --test 54/54; run_venture_tests.py node-version-drift-check ok; check_posts.py ok. No agent doc: the README and post carry what a later run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: write a seeded differential harness vs node-semver, triage disagreements, fix two parser/analysis bugs, docs and post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
